regex_contract.engine_selection: P13 selects a bounded adapter that proves this grammar; no engine chosen or added by P01. Translation allowed only with equivalence fixtures.
grammar: UTF-8 literal Unicode scalar text and escaped punctuation
^ and $ line anchors under multiline mode
numbered backreferences to earlier completed capture groups
rejected: Unicode property syntax beyond explicitly catalogued classes

resource_cases.expected: within ceiling; result depends only on exact matches

regex_contract.normalization: Never claim Go RE2 is full PCRE. -P grammar is explicitly this bounded PCRE-compatible subset. Preserve source span and original pattern in diagnostics.
regex_contract.character_policy: UTF-8 literals, dot/classes consume Unicode scalars; \d/\w/\s and word boundaries use fixed ASCII classes without UCP/locale. LF newline; ^/$ multiline matching, $ permits final-LF position. -i uses Unicode simple case-folding, no locale-dependent Turkish rules.
regex_contract.only_matching: Emit nonempty matches left-to-right, one LF-delimited match per output record; after zero-width match advance one Unicode scalar before next attempt, never infinite loop. -o does not emit empty records.
